/var/folders/5l/cq05cfts4ysgnv1ln1rxq_740000gn/T/perfproof-native.4YdHWO/prog/work.c:
    1|       |#include "work.h"
    2|       |
    3|       |/* FNV-1a: one multiply per byte, the loop the profile should name. */
    4|      1|uint64_t checksum(const uint8_t *data, size_t n) {
    5|      1|    uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ULL;
    6|      5|    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    7|      4|        h ^= data[i];
    8|      4|        h *= 1099511628211ULL;
    9|      4|    }
   10|      1|    return h;
   11|      1|}
   12|       |
   13|       |/* Insertion sort: quadratic on purpose, so it shows up next to the
   14|       | * checksum in a profile. */
   15|      1|void sort_ints(int *values, size_t n) {
   16|      3|    for (size_t i = 1; i < n; i++) {
   17|      2|        int v = values[i];
   18|      2|        size_t j = i;
   19|      4|        while (j > 0 && values[j - 1] > v) {
   20|      2|            values[j] = values[j - 1];
   21|      2|            j--;
   22|      2|        }
   23|      2|        values[j] = v;
   24|      2|    }
   25|      1|}
   26|       |
   27|      0|int never_called(int x) {
   28|      0|    if (x > 0) {
   29|      0|        return x * 2;
   30|      0|    }
   31|      0|    return -x;
   32|      0|}
